# Seminai

> Seminai is an AI-assisted agronomic management platform for Italian agriculture. It turns invoices, DDT (transport documents), field notebooks and agronomic disciplinari (compliance rulebooks) into structured data via OCR and domain-specialized language models, and gives agronomists and farms a chat agent for dosage, compliance and field operations.

Seminai serves two audiences: agricultural businesses and agronomist consultants who need document automation and compliance support, and developers/software houses who integrate document extraction via API.

## Product

- [Try Seminai](https://app.seminai.app/try-seminai): free invoice-to-Excel extraction for fitofarmaci (phytosanitary product) invoices.
- [Seminai App](https://app.seminai.app): full platform — document upload, AI chat agent, job tracking, compliance and rules marketplace.

## Knowledge Hub

- [Rules catalog](https://app.seminai.app/hub/rules): public catalog of agronomic disciplinari and best-practice rules shared by the Seminai community, filterable by category and region.
- [Blog](https://app.seminai.app/hub/blog): articles on document intelligence, agronomic compliance and API integration.

## Developer

- [Developer portal](https://seminai-be-v2-661301438659.europe-west1.run.app/developer): API keys, usage dashboard, OpenAPI documentation.
- [OCR landing & API docs](https://seminai.github.io/seminai-be-v2/): product overview and Extraction API usage.
